name: Citizens
overview: Scripture presents citizens as those who owe respect and obedience to their leaders, as seen when the Israelites pledged to follow Joshua's commands wholeheartedly. The duty to honor rulers is emphasized in the instruction not to curse the ruler of the people, underscoring the sacredness of authority. Instances of loyalty and unity are highlighted by the congregation's obedience, while examples of dissent, such as Miriam and Aaron's complaint against Moses, reveal the dangers of treason and rebellion within the community.
